parameters.help_en: The region ID of the instance. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/426062.html operation to query the most recent region list. Use this parameter to specify the region where you want to create the instance
parameters.help_zh: 实例的地域ID，可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/426062.html查询，使用此参数指定要创建实例的地域
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The zone ID of the instance
parameters.help_zh: 实例的可用区ID
parameters.name: zone_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the instance
parameters.help_zh: 实例的名称
parameters.name: instance_alias

parameters.help_en:
The storage type. If you select big data or local SSD, you do not need to specify this parameter.

Valid values:

PerformanceStorage: performance cloud storage.
StandardStorage: standard cloud storage.
CapacityStorage: capacity cloud storage
parameters.help_zh:
存储类型，选择大数据型与本地SSD时，该参数可以不传

PerformanceStorage: 性能型云存储
StandardStorage: 标准型云存储
CapacityStorage: 容量型云存储
parameters.name: cloud_storage_type

parameters.help_en:
The billing method of the instance. Valid values:

PREPAY: subscription.
POSTPAY: pay-as-you-go
parameters.help_zh:
实例的付费类型，取值：

PREPAY：包年包月（预付费）。
POSTPAY：按量付费（后付费）
parameters.name: pay_type

parameters.help_en: The VPC ID of the instance
parameters.help_zh: 实例的专有网络ID
parameters.name: vpc_id

parameters.help_en: The vSwitch ID
parameters.help_zh: 虚拟交换机的ID
parameters.name: vswitch_id

parameters.help_en:
The billing cycle of the instance. Valid values:

Month: month.
Year: year.

This parameter is available and required only when PayType is set to PREPAY
parameters.help_zh:
实例购买的付费周期，取值：

Month：单位为月。
Year：单位为年。

PayType取值为PREPAY时，本参数可用且必须传入
parameters.name: pricing_cycle

parameters.help_en:
The subscription duration of the instance. Valid values:

If PricingCycle is set to Month, the value ranges from 1 to 9.
If PricingCycle is set to Year, the value ranges from 1 to 3.

This parameter is available and required only when PayType is set to PREPAY
parameters.help_zh:
实例包年包月的时间，取值：

PricingCycle为Month，表示按月付费，取值范围为1~9。
PricingCycle为Year，表示按年付费，取值范围为1~3。

PayType取值为PREPAY时，本参数可用且必须传入
parameters.name: duration

parameters.help_en: The size of the cloud storage space. Unit: GB
parameters.help_zh: 云存储空间大小，单位GB
parameters.name: cloud_storage_size

parameters.help_en:
The deployment architecture. Valid values:

1.0: single-zone.
2.0: multi-zone basic edition.
3.0: multi-zone high-availability edition
parameters.help_zh:
部署架构，取值：

1.0：单可用区。
2.0：多可用区基础版。
3.0：多可用区高可用版
parameters.name: arch_version

parameters.help_en: The zone ID of the primary zone for a multi-zone instance. This parameter is required if you want to create a multi-zone instance
parameters.help_zh: 多可用区实例，主可用区的可用区ID。如果需要创建多可用区实例，该参数必填
parameters.name: primary_zone_id

parameters.help_en: The zone ID of the secondary zone for a multi-zone instance. This parameter is required if you want to create a multi-zone instance
parameters.help_zh: 多可用区实例，备可用区的可用区ID。如果需要创建多可用区实例，该参数必填
parameters.name: standby_zone_id

parameters.help_en: The zone ID of the arbiter zone for a multi-zone instance. This parameter is required if you want to create a multi-zone instance
parameters.help_zh: 多可用区实例，协调可用区的可用区ID。如果需要创建多可用区实例，该参数必填
parameters.name: arbiter_zone_id

parameters.help_en: The vSwitch ID of the primary zone for a multi-zone instance. The vSwitch must be deployed in the zone specified by PrimaryZoneId. This parameter is required if you want to create a multi-zone instance
parameters.help_zh: 多可用区实例，主可用区的虚拟交换机ID，必须在PrimaryZoneId对应的可用区下。如果需要创建多可用区实例，该参数必填
parameters.name: primary_vswitch_id

parameters.help_en: The vSwitch ID of the secondary zone for a multi-zone instance. The vSwitch must be deployed in the zone specified by StandbyZoneId. This parameter is required if you want to create a multi-zone instance
parameters.help_zh: 多可用区实例，备可用区的虚拟交换机ID，必须在StandbyZoneId对应的可用区下。如果需要创建多可用区实例，该参数必填
parameters.name: standby_vswitch_id

parameters.help_en: The vSwitch ID of the arbiter zone for a multi-zone instance. The vSwitch must be deployed in the zone specified by ArbiterZoneId. This parameter is required if you want to create a multi-zone instance
parameters.help_zh: 多可用区实例，协调可用区虚拟交换机ID，交换机需位于ArbiterZoneId对应的可用区下。如果需要创建多可用区实例，该参数必填
parameters.name: arbiter_vswitch_id

parameters.help_en: The resource group ID
parameters.help_zh: 资源组ID

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable auto-renewal for the instance. Valid values:
true: enables auto-renewal.
false: disables auto-renewal.

Default value: false.

This parameter is valid only when PayType is set to PREPAY (subscription)
parameters.help_zh:
实例是否自动续费，枚举值：
true：自动续费。
false：不自动续费。

默认值为false

仅当PayType取值为PREPAY（包年包月）时，此参数有效
parameters.name: auto_renewal

parameters.help_en:
The auto-renewal duration. Unit: month.

Valid values: 1 to 12.

This parameter takes effect only when AutoRenewal is set to true
parameters.help_zh:
自动续费时长。单位：月。

取值范围：1~12。

仅AutoRenewal为true时，该项才生效
parameters.name: auto_renew_duration

parameters.help_en:
The cluster pattern. Valid values:

basic: production

形态选择，取值：

basic：生产型

parameters.help_en:
The instance mode. This parameter is optional.

实例模式，非必填

fields.help_en:
The node specifications.

If you select performance cloud storage or standard cloud storage, valid values are:

lindorm.c.2xlarge: 8 vCPUs and 16 GB of memory.
lindorm.g.2xlarge: 8 vCPUs and 32 GB of memory.
lindorm.c.4xlarge: 16 vCPUs and 32 GB of memory.
lindorm.g.4xlarge: 16 vCPUs and 64 GB of memory.
lindorm.c.8xlarge: 32 vCPUs and 64 GB of memory.
lindorm.g.8xlarge: 32 vCPUs and 128 GB of memory.
lindorm.r.2xlarge: 8 vCPUs and 64 GB of memory.
lindorm.r.4xlarge: 16 vCPUs and 128 GB of memory.
lindorm.r.8xlarge: 32 vCPUs and 256 GB of memory.

If you select local SSD, valid values are:

lindorm.i4.xlarge: 4 vCPUs and 32 GB of memory (I4).
lindorm.i4.2xlarge: 8 vCPUs and 64 GB of memory (I4).
lindorm.i4.4xlarge: 16 vCPUs and 128 GB of memory (I4).
lindorm.i4.8xlarge: 32 vCPUs and 256 GB of memory (I4).
lindorm.i3.xlarge: 4 vCPUs and 32 GB of memory (I3).
lindorm.i3.2xlarge: 8 vCPUs and 64 GB of memory (I3).
lindorm.i3.4xlarge: 16 vCPUs and 128 GB of memory (I3).

lindorm.i2.4xlarge: 16 vCPUs and 128 GB of memory (I2).
lindorm.i2.8xlarge: 32 vCPUs and 256 GB of memory (I2).

If you select big data, valid values are:

lindorm.sd3c.3xlarge: 14 vCPUs and 56 GB of memory (D3C PRO).
lindorm.sd3c.7xlarge: 28 vCPUs and 112 GB of memory (D3C PRO).
lindorm.sd3c.14xlarge: 56 vCPUs and 224 GB of memory (D3C PRO).

lindorm.d1.6xlarge: 24 vCPUs and 96 GB of memory (D1NE)
